title: rubus hirtus var. orbiculatus
intro: Rubus hirtus var. orbiculatus, commonly known as the thimbleberry, is a type of deciduous shrub that belongs to the rose family (Rosaceae). The thimbleberry plant is known for its edible fruits, which are rich in nutrients and offer several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties that can help to boost the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of thimbleberry include wound healing, anti-cancer, and cardiovascular health promotion, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These bioactive compounds have been shown to exhibit anti-proliferative, anti-apoptotic, and anti-oxidative effects, making thimbleberry a valuable resource for natural medicine.
